# Step Analysis
The recorded steps demonstrate a complete workflow for creating a GitLab group. The agent:
1. Navigated to the group creation page (/groups/new)
2. Analyzed the page structure to identify all form fields
3. Entered group name "Test Automation Group"
4. Entered group URL "automation-demo-group" 
5. Entered description in textarea
6. Selected "Public" visibility radio button
7. Clicked "Create group" button
8. Successfully created the group (ID 2501)

# Task Definition
Create a tool that creates a new GitLab group by filling out the group creation form with customizable parameters.

# Action Plan
1. Navigate to the group creation page (/groups/new)
2. Input group name into the name field
3. Input group URL into the URL field  
4. Input description into the description textarea (optional)
5. Select visibility level via radio buttons
6. Click the "Create group" button

# Variable Identification
Based on the form structure and agent interactions:
1. `group_name` - Required text input for group name
2. `group_url` - Required text input for group URL/slug
3. `group_description` - Optional textarea for group description
4. `visibility_level` - Required radio selection for visibility (private/internal/public)

# Step Optimization
- All steps are essential for group creation
- Use deterministic steps with elementHash where available (all form fields have stable elementHash)
- No URL manipulation optimization possible - this is a POST form submission
- Remove all exploratory steps (search filters, sorting, notification settings, advanced permissions, subgroup/project creation) as they are not part of the core group creation task
